evals.prompt: Forge a reviewed change where all tests pass, but one changed runtime file has no direct execution or E2E trace evidence.
evals.expected_output: Forge must mark missing proof as a bug, append or require a contract item, recycle through TDD, and refuse FORGED until the runtime file has execution proof or a documented non-runtime reason.
assertions: Treats missing runtime proof as a forge bug.
Does not accept test count as sufficient evidence.
Requires contract/TDD recycle.
Refuses FORGED until proof exists.

evals.prompt: Forge a money/order/invoice change with SQL filters and a rendered UI result.
evals.expected_output: Forge must attack SQL precedence/type/sargability/falsy hazards, concurrency/idempotence, E2E workflow edges, tenant/security boundaries, headless UI proof, repo gate evidence, and record a structured attack lens packet with agent/session/receipt proof for every lens. Delegated attack lenses should use Codex headless by default after MCP preflight.
assertions: Attacks schema/query hazards with live DB proof.
Attacks concurrency and idempotence.
Requires headless UI proof.
Attacks repo gate matrix and stale evidence.
Uses Codex headless as the default delegated attack-lens runtime when delegation is available.
Records structured attack lens packet evidence with agent/session/receipt proof.

evals.prompt: Forge a high-risk inventory PR where Copilot reviewed an earlier commit, the latest commit changed query behavior, and comments are marked non-blocking.
evals.expected_output: Forge must treat the old Copilot review as stale for changed files, attack the high-risk draft/open exception, and require advisory-harvest routing for useful non-blocking comments while escalating correctness risks to blocking recycle.
assertions: Treats Copilot review on an older head as stale for changed files.
Attacks whether high-risk PR draft policy or open exception is justified.
Requires advisory-harvest routing for non-blocking comments.
Escalates credible correctness risks into contract/TDD recycle.

evals.prompt: Forge a change that introduces a new service seam which only forwards arguments and leaks retry ordering and query shape to every caller.
evals.expected_output: Forge must use the deep-module lens to attack shallow pass-through modules, leaked internals, one-adapter seams, and tests coupled to private implementation. Material findings should recycle into contract items or fail forge.
assertions: Applies the deep-module lens to changed seams.
Uses deletion test and locality/leverage reasoning.
Flags leaked retry, cache, ordering, or query-shape internals.
Classifies material architecture-depth failures as recycle-worthy bugs or blockers.

evals.prompt: Forge a browser-worker reliability lane where the report says PC-1 PASS at suite level, the accept route still returns the old payload, the contract required runId, bullmq queue id, worker identity, and readinessSnapshot, /api/health compatibility was not exercised, Chrome proof only hit /api/ready and an admin recovery UI, terminal worker branches and /data disk readiness were not proved, full SJS scrape/data semantics were claimed without source-to-consumer proof, and gate summary, Chrome proof, and final HEAD use different SHAs.
evals.expected_output: Forge must reject the lane. It must require contract clause coverage with source, executable assertion, and runtime proof for each clause; fail proof subject integrity because artifact heads drift; require a runtime surface inventory covering accept metadata, /api/health, /api/ready, terminal worker branches, disk/data volume readiness, and claimed scrape/data semantics; and recycle the missing clauses through contract/TDD instead of accepting PC-level PASS.
assertions: Rejects PC-level or suite-level PASS without clause-level source, assertion, and runtime proof.
Fails forge when final HEAD, gate summary, browser proof, receipt, or runtime provenance SHAs drift.
Requires runtime route/surface inventory for accept metadata, health/readiness routes, terminal branches, disk/data readiness, and scrape/data semantics.
Rejects Chrome proof that only exercises /api/ready and admin UI when the contract claims broader browser-worker behavior.
Treats vague receipts and stale artifacts as missing proof even when they say PASS.
Rejects full workflow or full-system claims when any in-scope browser-worker surface remains NOT PROVED.
Requires missing browser-worker clauses to recycle through contract/TDD before FORGED.

evals.prompt: Forge an async worker change where receipts show a passing unit suite and one Chrome smoke against readiness, but the report claims full-system reliability while queue retries, terminal failure branches, data persistence, and runtime volume health were not exercised and one receipt predates the final commit.
evals.expected_output: Forge must reject the final claim. It must mark vague suite/smoke receipts and stale artifacts as missing proof, build a proved/not-proved surface inventory, narrow the proof scope to the proved subset or fail, and recycle the missing runtime branches and data semantics through contract/TDD.
assertions: Rejects vague suite or smoke receipts as proof for unexercised runtime surfaces.
Fails stale receipt or pre-final-commit artifact provenance.
Requires proved/not-proved inventory before accepting async worker claims.
Rejects full-system reliability claims from subset proof.
Routes missing runtime branches and data semantics back to contract/TDD.

evals.prompt: Forge a reviewed diff where tests pass, but the operator acceptance from the original vague request is not proved, a touched mixed service skipped its fix-now refactor, and a read-only live-proof SELECT bypasses the owning reader seam.
evals.expected_output: Forge must reject the lane. It must apply intent-continuity, touched-file SRP, and DB/query ownership lenses; classify the skipped fix-now refactor and unowned read-only query as forge bugs; require owner seam, current DB/schema, scope predicates, bounded proof, readback, cleanup, and redaction evidence; and recycle missing rows through contract/TDD before FORGED.
assertions: Attacks original user intent and operator acceptance proof, not just test pass status.
Treats skipped fix-now touched-file SRP/refactor as a forge bug.
Requires DB/query ownership for read-only SELECT/live-proof queries.
Requires bounded proof, readback, cleanup, current DB/schema, and scoping evidence.
Recycles missing intent, SRP, and query ownership rows through contract/TDD.

evals.prompt: Forge a reviewed PR after a code pivot where normal tests pass, but no artifact proves the recent trap classes: stale UI rehydration, config outage/unlinked semantics, proof-lane false greens, stale proof-subject preflight, weak assertions, DB ownership, integration side effects, redaction, and SRP domain boundaries.
evals.expected_output: Forge must apply a Last-150 PR replay lens, classify missing applicable rows as forge bugs, and recycle them through contract/TDD before FORGED.
assertions: Applies a Last-150 PR replay lens or equivalent current trap-bank attack.
Treats missing applicable stale UI/config/proof-lane/proof-subject/weak-assertion rows as forge bugs.
Requires DB/query ownership, integration fault/idempotency, redaction, and SRP/domain proof where applicable.
Rejects stale pre-pivot proof after code changed.
Recycles missing trap rows through contract/TDD before FORGED.
